title: Claude Code subagent frontmatter (project, user and managed agents)
description: Every field the subagents reference documents, and nothing else: Claude Code ignores a field it does not recognize without reporting an error, and skips files without a name or description, with a bad name, with unparseable YAML, or whose opening --- is not on line 1, all without reporting it in the session.

x-source.revision: unversioned documentation page; version gates stated through v2.1.281

name.description: Required. Must not start with '-' or contain ':' (reserved for plugin-scoped identifiers); Claude Code skips such a file and logs the reason only to the debug log. The filename need not match.

description.description: Required: when Claude should delegate to this subagent. A file with a name but no description is skipped.

tools.description: Comma-separated string or YAML list; inherits every subagent tool if omitted.

disallowedTools.description: Same format as tools; applied first.

model.description: An alias, `inherit`, or a full model ID such as claude-opus-5-5.

maxTurns.description: The reference states no type; a positive integer is the only reading its behaviour supports.

omitClaudeMd.description: Requires Claude Code v2.1.271 or later.

experimental.description: Only cacheTtl is read (v2.1.248+); any other key is ignored.

permissionMode.description: `manual` (an alias for default) requires v2.1.200 or later.

mcpServers.description: A configured server's name, or {name: <.mcp.json server config>}.

hooks.description: Event map, as in settings hooks.
